entries.message: Fix - Show real episode names on watched shows and polish the Up Next rail
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Dashboard and history episode cards now use the actual episode name stored on the watch record; watches received from a media server as only a coordinate ("S1E5") get the real name resolved from stored metadata at ingest so the card never falls back to a placeholder

Database Repairs gains a Restore Missing Episode Names tool that backfills a real episode name onto watch rows that only stored a coordinate (audit shows affected rows first; restore resolves stored data then a metadata lookup when needed)

The Up Next rail no longer paints the same next-up episode twice and stops wrongly merging re-releases/reboots that share a title but aired in a different year; removing a tile now animates it out before an overlapping refresh repaints
